detail.query: Build a composite score for Colorado counties from the unemployment rate and median household income, counting unemployment twice as heavily as income; low income should raise the score.
detail.intent: A composite score for Colorado counties based on unemployment rate and median household income, with unemployment weighted twice as heavily as income, where low income raises the score
adjustments: Composite: composite of percentile ranks, weighted sum, the weights stated: Unemployment rate, percent of the civilian labor force unemployed, annual average (BLS LAU 66.7% (higher scores higher); Median household income in dollars 33.3% (lower scores higher).

detail.query: For Tennessee counties, combine the poverty rate, diabetes prevalence and the unemployment rate as a geometric mean of percentile ranks, so a county at the bottom on any one of them scores zero. Map the score for every county.
